key_idea: Obstruct the existence of A ≅ C^[4] by passing to the associated graded algebra of the p-adic valuation, lifting a homogeneous LND to a line bundle that principalizes the ideal (f,g) over the determinant-type threefold, and ruling out the resulting derivation with E^2(v)=0 by a Mason–Stothers rigidity argument, while the cylinder is trivialized explicitly via an exponential automorphism and a polynomial root modulo p^3.
reason: The overall plan is a sophisticated, well-chosen degeneration-plus-rigidity strategy (in the spirit of Makar-Limanov/Gupta invariants), and the stabilization via exp(wΔ) and an explicit fifth coordinate is clever, but the argument is a long chain of propositions with heavy explicit identities, line-bundle principalization and lifting machinery. The underlying reason why A is not C^[4] is visible only through the layered reductions rather than as a single inevitable idea.
